title: Apollo 17 trio of blue lights

tellings.quote: see three solidish looking blue lights almost equally distant from each other and in a very small area of the lunar sky

plain: A researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, describes a sighting from Apollo 17, a 1972 Moon landing mission run by NASA, the US space agency. He says a raw scan of a photo frame from the mission shows "three solidish looking blue lights", spaced almost evenly apart in a small patch of the lunar sky above the landing site. He tells it because, if it holds up, something unexplained would have been photographed on the Moon.
